subject: Pilot pause: extension request due to build freeze
messages:
From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@voltix.ai>
To: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Chu <tom@voltix.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot pause: can we extend the sandbox + credits?

Hi Dev + Ben,

Quick note — we hit an unexpected blocker in our SSO adapter after a refactor over the weekend. The connector that maps identities is failing 500s in staging; our engineers are blocked and we can't run the next round of data pipelines or the scheduled demo on Friday.

Would Redwood be able to: 1) extend our pilot window by two weeks, and 2) top up our sandbox with 5,000 credits so the team can continue testing once they unfreeze the build? We don't expect this to take more than 10 business days to fix but we want to avoid losing momentum.

I've attached the initial stack trace and a screenshot of the admin console errors (integration-log.txt, error_screenshot.png).

Can we hop on a quick 30-min call today or tomorrow to align?

Thanks —
Alyssa Gomez
Head of Product, Voltix AI
alyssa@voltix.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@voltix.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause: can we extend the sandbox + credits?

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and for the logs.

Sorry to hear about the refactor fallout. We can absolutely support an extension; on our side I'll flag this with Solutions/SE to validate the request and determine how quickly we can provision credits. Tentative: we can approve a 2-week pilot extension and provision an initial 3,000 sandbox credits immediately pending SE confirmation. I'm looping in Kimberly to confirm the credit top-up and whether we can bump to the full 5,000 now.

Also, can you share the specific API calls that started failing (timestamped examples)? That'll help SE triage faster.

Best,
Dev
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
(510) 555-0107

From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@voltix.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tom Chu <tom@voltix.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause: can we extend the sandbox + credits?

Thanks Dev — attaching a slightly larger dump (error_dump.zip) with the failing requests (failing_api_calls.csv inside). The failing endpoints are POST /auth/link and a batch webhook /ingest/batch between 2026-06-17T22:00:00Z and 2026-06-18T02:00:00Z.

If Redwood can front 4k credits immediately that would keep our QA team running while engineers fix the adapter. We appreciate the flexibility — Ben, does Redwood have any expedited credits program for pilots in active troubleshooting?

Alyssa

-----Original message-----

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@voltix.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause: can we extend the sandbox + credits?

Hi Alyssa — Kim from SE here. Thanks for the extra artifacts; I reviewed the failing_api_calls.csv and the stack traces.

Good news: the errors look related to a backwards-incompatible header change in your auth proxy. We can help with a short patch and have an engineer pair with yours for 2 hours to validate. Separately on the commercial side, I've approved an immediate 4,000 sandbox-credit allocation so QA can continue. If the pairing confirms the fix within 72 hours we'll consider an additional 1,000 credits as a make-good.

I'll attach a short runbook (runbook.pdf) that outlines the quick checks and a recommended patch. When are your engineers available for pairing today or tomorrow (PST)?

-Kimberly
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@voltix.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pause: can we extend the sandbox + credits?

Alyssa — confirming the approval: 2-week pilot extension granted (new end date 2026-07-06) and 4,000 immediate sandbox credits have been added to Voltix's sandbox account. Deal ID D-4721-Voltix has been updated in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4721

Kimberly will coordinate the SE pairing. Dev, I'll leave the scheduling and follow-ups to you and Kimberly; happy to join the call if helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you back on track.

Ben Carter
Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
